Use case: illustration-story. Create a NEW transparent production animation-part atlas for PICO, the mountain hare shown at top-left of Image1. Image1 is the new Horizons art direction; Image2 is graphic style reference only. Match Pico's NEW angular, witty graphic design: long softly rectangular hare muzzle, small white oval eyes with navy pupils, strong expressive eyebrow, flat triangular orange nose, open magenta mouth, tall straight ear and bent ear, slim warm-cream body in a simple NAVY VEST, broad flat feet, magenta satchel. NOT a baby rabbit, not old rounded mascot art, not a 3D plush figure.
Exactly4columns×4rows, separate well-spaced parts with transparent gutters. Row1: complete head WITHOUT ears, facing slightly right, eyes/nose/brow/mouth together; sleeveless torso in navy vest with no head/limbs/satchel; straight left ear; bent right ear. Row2: left upper arm, diagonal rounded capsule; left forearm ending in a downward relaxed simple paw; right upper arm, diagonal rounded capsule; right forearm with an open friendly paw, clear elbow-to-wrist line and small fingers. Row3: left thigh; left lower leg with broad foot pointing LEFT; right thigh; right lower leg with broad foot pointing RIGHT. Row4: separate magenta satchel with orange button; separate diagonal curved magenta strap; small open navy book with orange spine and flat cream pages; folded cream map with bold green hills, blue lake and orange dotted route. Everypart alone, no attached neighboringparts, no part labels/grid/text.
Everymaterial is ONE uniform opaque color. Use geometric silhouettes and crisp antialiased edges. NO SHADOWS: no neck-shadow triangles or dark ear-base shading from the master; no side-plane lighting, gradients, rim light, highlights, texture, soft shading, beveled joints, folds or endcap rings. Allcream fur same #FFE1B8; vest/eyes navy#183B56; earinterior orange#FF9230; satchelmagenta#BC185B. Flat intentional vest/material panels allowed. Genuinely transparent alpha outside silhouettes; no ground, glow or shadow. All parts fully inside canvas, square atlas. Retain the master’s designed expression and proportions.

prompt: Create one NEW simple profile navigation icon for Horizons, inspired by the graphic adult avatar busts at BOTTOM of Image1. Image2 is style reference. A single original adult upper-chest bust with a softly rectangular/angular peach face, strong angular nose and eyebrow, small white eyes, tall sweeping navy quiff, broad teal collar shoulders. Three-quarter friendly view, stylish geometric silhouette, not a baby or roundheaded doll. Fit entirely inside a square with ample transparent margins. Absolutely flat opaque color blocks, no shadows, shading, gradients, highlights, texture, 3D, outlines, ground or background. No text. Clean transparent alpha.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this profile icon ONLY to remove modeled shading. Keep exact silhouette, pose, face, glasses, hair and clothing geometry. REMOVE the dark triangular shadow under the chin: the ENTIRE neck and face must be one uniform flat peach color. Remove cheek side-plane gradients, hair gradients and dark lit/shaded collar planes. Keep a flat orange nose, black pupils/eyebrows and dark glasses as facial features. Make navy hair one solid navy, teal jacket one solid teal, cream shirt one solid cream. Glass lenses flat white without shine. No shadow, highlight, gradient, texture, bevel or 3D anywhere. No new shapes, no outline. Preserve transparent alpha outside silhouette. This is crisp FLAT vector-cutout illustration with intentionally different material colors only.
